payload.title: File:Howesia browni (SAM-PK-K10180, right lateral).jpg
payload.artist_html: S. N. F. Spiekman, C. Browning, M. Tshibalanganda, D. Mukherjee, R. M. H. Smith, A. Du Plessis & F. Wolvaardt
payload.credit_html: "Micro-CT informed cranial anatomy of the early rhynchosaur Howesia browni, with implications for rhynchosaur skull evolution"
payload.description_html: Howesia browni SAM-PK-K10180 in right lateral view. A, photograph. B–C, μCT-derived reconstruction; C, with overlying manus and carpal elements removed. Bones are labelled; other relevant morphological structures are marked in bold and underlined. Abbreviations: an, angular; aoc, anguli ori crest; asp, ascending process; dc, distal carpal; de, dentary; epi, epipterygoid; fib, fibula; fr, frontal; hy, hyoid; j, jugal; l., left; la, lacrimal; mc, metacarpal; mt, metatarsal; mx, maxilla; mxf, maxilla facet; na, nasal; pa, parietal; po, postorbital; pof, postfrontal; pofa, postorbital facet; prf, prefrontal; q, quadrate; qj, quadratojugal; sa, surangular; scl, scleral ossicles; spl, splenial; sq, squamosal; st, supratemporal; tib, tibia. Scale bar represents 20 mm.
